<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="total" expr="0"/><data id="list" expr="[1, 2]"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" cond="total => 1" target="b"/>
    <transition event="go2" cond="(total) =>  total + 1" target="b"/>
    <transition event="go3" cond="list.some(x => x > 1)" target="b"/>
    <transition event="go4" cond="(a, b) => a" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `cond` on `<transition>` is an arrow function, so it is always true
notes: in ECMAScript `x => 1` is a function whose parameter is `x`; a condition is converted to a boolean without calling it, and every function is truthy, so the condition always holds
diagnostics.help: to test whether `total` is at least the value, compare with `>=`
